reviewer_provenance.source: Read-only comparison of the 42-frame source with approved Aula 16, LessonDesign and POO profile. Preserves optional insurance, contract and collaborator roles, reference fields and first valid closing, delegation, faulty implementations, extension impact, JUnit and observing collaborator, void effect transfer and message bridge. Excluded topics remain outside the deck. Every activity has its visible answer immediately afterward. Schema validation uses the current jsonschema Registry API with unchanged Docemas schemas to avoid the legacy RefResolver nested-reference scope error; all deterministic semantic checks remain enabled. Visual checks are separate.
